## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12. Owner ruling of 14 Nov 2026: every screen in every app has the same frame: small sidebar, top bar, full-width content, sticky bottom bar holding every action button.

Persona and route: Every screen with an action in web/clinic and web/platform-admin.
Rationale: MDV-P2-063 and MDV-P2-064 put the bottom bar on registration and the clinic task screens. The platform console has none (no StickyActionBar in web/platform-admin), and about 15 clinic pages still hold their content to the reading or form width (PageContainer width reading or form), leaving the right of a wide screen empty.
Proposed UX behaviour: Every remaining screen with an action moves its buttons (OK, Save, Add, Create, Confirm, Cancel) into StickyActionBar, in both apps; dialogs and drawers pin their own footer. Pages drop the reading and form width caps; fields sit side by side in an auto-fit grid; only paragraphs keep the reading width. Print pages (note print, token slip) keep their print widths. No field, rule, wording or validation changes.
Components and tokens affected: StickyActionBar, PageContainer widths.
Front end and back end split: Front end only.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: M · Medium: many screens, layout only.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Print layouts. (2) The mobile apps.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given every screen with an action in both apps at 1440 by 900 and 1024 by 768, when it renders, then its action buttons are in the bottom bar and visible without scrolling
- [ ] **AC2.** Given 1920 px, when any form page renders, then its fields span the content width and only paragraphs are held to about 72 characters
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the platform console, when a review or settings screen renders, then it has the sidebar, top bar, full-width content and bottom bar frame
- [ ] **AC4.** Given English and Arabic, when axe runs, then there is no violation

## Test notes

- tests/e2e: commitVisible and fitsOneScreen checks per screen in both apps; platform-console.spec.ts.
